text.en:
1. (1) This Act may be cited as the Tolls (Roads and
Bridges) Act, 1965, and shall come into force on such date
as the Minister may by notification in the Gazette‘ appoint,
such date not being earlier than the date on which the
notification is published.

(2) This Act shall apply only to the States of Malaya.

2. (1) It shall be lawful for the Minister charged with
responsibility for works with the concurrence of the

—Treasury, from time to time by order to impose tolls to be
paid for the use by vehicles of such roads or any part thereof
or of such bridges as may be specified in the order.

In this section, the expressions "roads" and "bridges"
mean federal roads and federal bridges, respectively.

(2) Any order made under sub-section (1) shall specify—

(a) the vehicles or any class thereof in respect of which
tolls are payable;

(b) the amounts of such tolls;
(c) the place where such tolls are to be collected; and
(d) the person to whom such tolls are to be paid.

3. The Minister may cause a barrier to be erected across
the road at any place where tolls. are to be paid, and such
barrier may be kept closed against any vehicle until the toll
due in respect of such vehicle has been paid.
